brief:
Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu has ordered a lockdown of the West Bank and a siege of Hebron, according to Middle East Eye. The restrictions come as Israel prepares for a vote and Palestinians face new movement controls across the territory.

The reported measures coincide with an alleged attack on Druze citizens, though details of the incident remain limited. The timing suggests the restrictions may be linked to broader security developments in the region.
dek: Israeli press review: Israel to lockdown West Bank as Netanyahu orders Hebron siege Submitted by Nadav Rapaport on Sun, 10/25/2026 - 14:48 As Israel prepares to vote, Palestinians face new movement restrictions and a reported attack on Druze citizens fuels…
title: Netanyahu orders lockdown of West Bank and siege of Hebron
